titulo.alumno: Saying you didn't understand and asking people to repeat

intro: In this lesson you will practice saying you didn't understand and asking people to repeat.

texto: Ask for a repetition or a spelling politely; confirm the detail before ending the exchange.

frases.alumno: What word do we learn today?

frases.estudio: Μπορείτε να επαναλάβετε το επώνυμό σας, παρακαλώ;
frases.alumno: Could you repeat your last name, please?

frases.estudio: Πώς γράφεται το όνομά σας; Με άλφα, νι και άλφα.
frases.alumno: How is your name spelled? With alpha, nu and alpha.

frases.estudio: Το τηλέφωνό μου είναι 69 1234 5678. Είναι σωστό;
frases.alumno: My phone number is 69 1234 5678. Is it correct?

pregunta.texto: Listen to the request and choose which detail needs confirmation.
